獎項
AWARDS



                               第十四屆公益節暨 ESG 影響力年會「2024 年度 ESG 創新獎」
                               二零二五年一月，由數央網、數央公益聯合眾多媒體共同舉辦的第十四屆公益節暨 ESG 影響力年
                               會在北京召開，四環醫藥榮獲「2024 年度 ESG 創新獎」。四環醫藥一直重視 ESG 管理，將可持續發
                               展理念融入戰略決策和日常運營，積極履行社會責任，通過多方面回饋社會。該榮譽激勵本集團
                               繼續深化可持續發展戰略，致力於達到更高標準。

                               本次峰會主題聚焦 ESG、可持續發展，致敬公益與 ESG 引領者，共築可持續發展未來，是中國公益
                               慈善及 ESG 領域極具影響力的年度盛會。繼二零二三年度四環醫藥獲得「ESG 先鋒企業獎」之後，
                               本次峰會再次榮獲「二零二四年度 ESG 創新獎」，彰顯社會媒體和業內專家對四環醫藥 ESG 工作取
                               得成績的充分認可。

                               “2024 ESG Innovation Award” at the 14th China
                               Philanthropy Festival and ESG Summit
                               In January 2025, the 14th China Philanthropy Festival and ESG Summit, jointly organized by Syobserve.
                               com, Gongyi Daily and numerous media outlets, was held in Beijing. Sihuan Pharmaceutical was
                               awarded the “2024 ESG Innovation Award”. Sihuan Pharmaceutical has always attached great
                               importance to ESG management, integrating the concepts of sustainable development into its strategic
                               decision-making and daily operations while actively fulfilling social responsibilities and giving back to
                               society in diverse methods. The accolade motivates the Group to continue to deepen its strategies for
                               sustainable development and strive to achieve even higher standards.
                               The theme of the summit focused on ESG and sustainable development, honoring the leaders of public
                               welfare and ESG and creating a sustainable future together. It is a highly influential annual event in the
                               fields of public welfare and ESG in China. After winning the “ESG Pioneer Enterprise Award” in 2023,
                               Sihuan Pharmaceutical won the “2024 ESG Innovation Award” again at the summit, demonstrating the
                               widespread recognition of the achievements in Sihuan Pharmaceutical’s ESG efforts by social media and
                               industry experts.



                               第三屆國際綠色零碳節「2024ESG 典範企業獎」
                               二零二四年七月，由數央網、數央公益聯合國內眾多大眾及財經媒體共同主辦的 2024 第三屆國際
                               綠色零碳節暨 2024ESG 領袖峰會在北京舉行，四環醫藥榮獲「2024 ESG 典範企業獎」，這是四環醫
                               藥繼二零二四年一月份斬獲 ESG 先鋒企業獎之後的又一殊榮，充分表明了社會各界以及資本市場
                               對四環醫藥 ESG 工作的再度認可與肯定。

                               一直以來，四環醫藥堅定地堅持綠色可持續發展的目標，積極踐行 ESG（環境、社會、企業管治）理念，
                               將環境、企業、社會責任等要素全面融入到組織的各項經營任務之中。通過大力開展研發創新、
                               不斷優化工藝、積極進行技術改造等方式，成功實現了各項節能減排，有效降低了能耗。未來，
                               四環醫藥將繼續秉持初心，以更高的標準、更堅定的決心踐行 ESG 理念，為推動全球經濟的綠色、
                               可持續發展貢獻更多力量。

                               “2024 ESG Exemplary Enterprise Award” at the 3rd
                               International Green Zero Carbon Festival
                               In July 2024, the 3rd International Green Zero Carbon Festival 2024 and the 2024 ESG Leaders
                               Summit, jointly organized by Syobserve.com, Gongyi Daily as well as numerous public and financial
                               media outlets, was held in Beijing. Sihuan Pharmaceutical was awarded the “2024 ESG Exemplary
                               Enterprise Award”, which is another accolade for Sihuan Pharmaceutical Group after winning the ESG
                               Pioneer Award in January 2024, fully demonstrating another recognition and affirmation of Sihuan
                               Pharmaceutical’s ESG efforts from the society and the capital market.

                               Sihuan Pharmaceutical has always firmly adhered to the goal of green and sustainable development,
                               actively practicing ESG (Environment, Social and Corporate Governance) concepts and fully
                               integrating environmental, corporate, social responsibility factors into various operational tasks of
                               the organization. Through vigorous R&D innovation, continuous process optimization and proactive
                               technological improvements, Sihuan Pharmaceutical has successfully achieved energy conservation
                               and emission reduction in various aspects, effectively lowering energy consumption. In the future,
                               Sihuan Pharmaceutical will continue to uphold its founding mission, and realize ESG concepts with
                               higher standards and greater resolve to further contribute to the promotion of green and sustainable

年內，軒竹生物自主研發的 1 類創                   During the Year, the IND application of XZP-7797 was accepted by the
新藥 XZP-7797 的 IND 申請獲國家藥            NMPA and was approved for IND at the beginning of 2025, it is a Class 1
監局受理並於二零二五年初獲批                      innovative drug developed by Xuanzhu Biopharm. XZP-7797 is a potent,
IND。XZP-7797 是 一 款 強 效、具 有          highly selective, low blood toxicity PARP1 (poly ADP-ribose polymerase
高選擇性、低血液毒性且能夠到達                     1) inhibitor that can reach brain lesions. The first-generation PARP1/2
腦 部 病 灶 的 多 聚 ADP 核 糖 聚 合 酶         inhibitors have been approved for the treatment of various cancers with
1(PARP1) 抑 制 劑。第 一 代 PARP1/2        BRCA (Breast Cancer Susceptibility Gene) mutations, including ovarian
抑制劑已被批准用於治療伴有乳                      cancer, prostate cancer, pancreatic cancer, and breast cancer. However,
腺 癌 易 感 基 因 (BRCA) 突 變 的 卵 巢        PARP1/2 inhibitors have caused significant hematological toxicity in clinical
癌、前列腺癌、胰腺癌和乳腺癌等                     applications. Research data indicates that the synthetic lethality in cancers
多 種 癌 症。然 而，PARP1/2 抑 制 劑           with BRCA mutations is mainly due to the inhibition of PARP1, while the
在臨床應用中產生了較嚴重的血                      hematological toxicity mainly due to the inhibition of PARP2. Therefore,
液 學 毒 性，研 究 數 據 表 明，對 有             as a highly selective PARP1 inhibitor, XZP-7797 is expected to maintain
BRCA 突變的合成致死性主要源於                   therapeutic efficacy while reducing hematological adverse reactions
對 PARP1 的抑制，而血液學毒性主                 associated with PARP2 inhibition. Additionally, statistical analysis shows
要來自於對 PARP2 的抑制。因此，                 that approximately 20% of patients with advanced cancer experience brain
XZP-7797 作為一款高選擇性 PARP1             metastases, and about 44.7% of patients with recurrent metastatic breast
抑制劑有望在保持療效的同時減                      cancer carrying BRCA1 mutations are diagnosed with brain metastases.
少 與 PARP2 抑 制 相 關 的 血 液 學 不         However, most first-generation PARP inhibitors cannot cross the blood-
良 反 應，另 外，統 計 分 析 顯 示，              brain barrier, thereby restricting their control over brain lesions. XZP-7797,
約 20% 的 晚 期 癌 症 患 者 會 出 現 腦         with its ability to reach brain lesions, demonstrates an advantage over most
轉 移，攜 帶 BRCA1 突 變 的 復 發 性           first-generation PARP inhibitors.
轉 移 性 乳 腺 癌 患 者 中 約 44.7% 被
診斷為腦轉移。然而，大多數一代
PARP 抑 制 劑 無 法 透 過 血 腦 屏 障，
從 而 限 制 了 對 腦 部 病 灶 的 控 制，
XZP-7797 憑 藉 其 能 夠 到 達 腦 部 病

二零二二年股份獎勵計劃為一項股份激勵計劃，          The 2022 Share Award Scheme is a share incentive scheme and is established to
乃為認可及表彰承授人對本集團所作出或可能           recognize and acknowledge the contributions which the grantees have made or may
作出的貢獻而設立。二零二二年股份獎勵計劃           make to the Group. The 2022 Share Award Scheme will provide the grantees with
將向承授人提供個人持有本公司股權的機會，           the opportunity to own a personal stake in the Company with a view to achieving the
以達至以下目標：(i) 激勵承授人；及╱或 (ii) 吸   following objectives: (i) motivating the grantees; and/or (ii) attracting and retaining or
引及挽留所作貢獻有利、將有利或可能有利於           otherwise maintaining on-going relationship with the grantees whose contributions are,
本集團長期發展的承授人，或以其他方式與彼           will be or are likely to be beneficial to the long-term growth of the Group.
等維持持續關係。

       公司指本公司直接或間接控制之                       indirectly, controlled by the Company. Control is achieved when the Group

       對象可變回報之風險或權利，並能                      the investee (i.e., existing rights that give the Group the current ability to

       報金額（即現有權利可使本集團能
       於當時指示投資對象之相關活動），
       即代表本集團擁有控制權。


       一般情況下推定多數投票權形成                       Generally, there is a presumption that a majority of voting rights results

  略 釐 定 可 資 比 較 公 眾 公 司，並 就 識 別 出      based on industry, size, leverage and strategy, and to calculate an appropriate

  數，例 如 企 業 價 值 對 除 利 息、稅 項、折          depreciation and amortisation (“EV/EBITDA”) multiple and price to earnings (“P/E”)
  舊及攤銷前盈利（「EV/EBITDA」）倍數及價             multiple, for each comparable company identified. The multiple is calculated by
  格對盈利（「P/E」）倍數。倍數乃以可資比                dividing the enterprise value of the comparable company by an earnings measure.
  較公司的企業價值除以盈利衡量計算得                    The trading multiple is then discounted for considerations such as illiquidity and
  出。交 易 倍 數 以 各 可 資 比 較 公 司 根 據 公      size differences between the comparable companies based on company-specific
  司 獨 有 因 素 及 情 況 的 考 慮 因 素，例 如 非      facts and circumstances. The discounted multiple is applied to the corresponding
  流 通 性 及 規 模 差 異，予 以 貼 現。貼 現 倍        earnings measure of the unlisted equity investments to measure the fair value.
  數用於非上市股權投資的相應盈利衡量                    The directors believe that the estimated fair values resulting from the valuation
  以 計 量 公 平 值。董 事 認 為 估 值 方 法 得 出      technique, which are recorded in the consolidated statement of financial position,
  的估計公平值（記錄於綜合財務狀況表）                   and the related changes in fair values, which are recorded in the consolidated
  及相關公平值變動（記錄於綜合損益）屬                   profit or loss, are reasonable, and that they were the most appropriate values at
  合理，並為年末最合適的價值。                       the end of the year.


  對於按公平值計入其他全面收益的非上                    For the fair value of the unlisted equity investments at fair value through other
  市 股 權 投 資 的 公 平 值，管 理 層 已 估 計 使      comprehensive income, management has estimated the potential effect of using

      狀況之變化對其作出調整。為維持                       light of changes in economic conditions. To maintain or adjust the capital
      或調整資本架構，本集團可能調整                       structure, the Group may adjust the dividend payments to shareholders,
      向股東派付之股息款項、向股東退                       return capital to shareholders or issue new shares. The Group is not subject
      回資本或發行新股。本集團毋須遵                       to any externally imposed capital requirements. No changes were made in
      守任何外部施加的資本規定。截至                       the objectives, policies or processes for managing capital during the years
